title: Quenched SLE₃ limits for general weak random-bond Ising models
summary: For the planar Ising model with bonds $`J_e=1+\varepsilon\xi_e`$, where the ξ e have any fixed bounded, nondegenerate, mean-zero iid law, we prove quenched chordal SLE 3 convergence for sufficiently small ε > 0. The temperature is the spontaneous-magnetization threshold. Convergence holds in probability over environments for the full oriented curve law in deterministic Jordan-domain approximations.
family_title: Conformal universality for weakly interacting and random-bond Ising models

review.reason: Extends quenched SLE3 limits to general weak random-bond Ising models with small disorder.
